request: Fix the silent slice-scoping fallback in the epic-child drift check. (1) sliceSection anchors the slice heading with \s*$, so a titled heading `## Slice B1 — ports and the server composition root` returns null. (2) sliceAcIds requires a leading `-` bullet, but every epic spec on disk writes `**ACs**: AC-001.` with no dash. (3) drift_check.parseAcs widens an empty scope to the spec's full AC list with no marker, so a scoping failure is indistinguishable from a slice that owns every AC and reports the whole epic as unresolved drift. Primary fix: make the empty-scope case distinguishable and report it. Follow-on: widen both regexes, backward compatible.
